A keeps all its text over darker sky, but its gradient fades into a muddy brownish orange at the bottom and the whole hero feels plainer and less festive. | pass 2 (A=without, B=with): B keeps all of the text, including the tagline and dates, over the darker purple part of the sky, and its orange button stands out clearly against the mauve behind it.
